proposedInterfaceDecisions: Preserve old text-v1 behavior/receipts; explicitly version new capability and context representation if schema shape or authority changes. Old clients/centers fail clearly for unsupported attachments while original plain text remains usable.

One canonical policy declares accepted text extensions/media types, strict round-trip UTF8, per-file upload limit, project retained/count limit, combined context refs/raw/code-unit/encoded budgets; validate config server-side once, publish actual limits to UI, enforce at upload, freeze and claim decode. Bytes are not model tokens; actual model/token capacity must remain unknown unless provided by the selected execution profile.

Keep stored upload size and actual context selection separate. Larger stored files may require explicit bounded excerpt selection; full selected material cannot be silently truncated. Preview/body reads stay lazy, bounded and cancellable. Do not duplicate upload/storage systems.

Origin must distinguish uploaded resource, existing knowledge citation, and authorized workspace/runner snapshot. Workspace support requires existing owner-provided project/runner/root grant plus opaque identity/version/digest and controlled snapshot/read; browser display paths alone grant no read. Selected immutable snapshot must survive Send/Queue/retry/recovery, and in-use content cannot be recycled.

Keep button/drop/keyboard and pane/view/project/connection identity through installed assistant-ui adapter and registry. Preserve unknown same-key retry and frozen ACK checks; actual provider unsupported cannot silently drop material.

Freeze shared contract/storage/context/claim consumer shape before backend implementation, then allow separate Web input work against fixed typed fixtures; actual App integration waits for Recovery scope handoff. Check shared ownership and reserve new migration number through existing Lead, no implicit take.
